rows.condition: owner, authoritative endpoint, expected_context, trust_anchor or replay key missing
rows.recovery: named owner supplies externally verifiable anchor/channel metadata
rows.expiry: policy, owner, endpoint or key change

rows.condition: partial, placeholder, TEST_ONLY, self-supplied or shape-only response
canonical bytes, signature, receipt or SHA-256 mismatch
rows.retain: both byte digests and verifier output
rows.recovery: resign exact canonical bytes; independently recompute

rows.condition: project root/profile/chain/EKU/name constraint unknown, foreign or revoked
rows.recovery: fresh externally pinned project anchor and path receipt

rows.condition: CRL/OCSP/trusted time unavailable, stale, unsigned or issuer-unbound
rows.recovery: fresh signed revocation and trusted-time package

rows.condition: nonce reuse, sequence rollback/gap, idempotency conflict or replay-window expiry
rows.recovery: new authorized nonce only after valid new request; unchanged inputs forbid new AD

rows.retain: conflicting refs, hashes and graph receipt
rows.recovery: same-candidate signed closure and rebuild all downstream identities
provider supplies complete signed candidate-bound closure

rows.condition: foreign-owner privileged test fixture unavailable or privilege not already held
rows.recovery: authorized owner runs fixture under existing privilege and returns raw receipt
channel owner supplies endpoint/ack contract and real receipt

rows.condition: program exception, malformed JSON, duplicate key or non-finite number
rows.retain: exit code, PID, UTC and stderr
rows.recovery: repair input/tool; rerun only under same declared request policy

retry_policy: bounded retry only with the declared idempotency key and channel policy; never blind repeat
promotion_rule: typed_absence is not present; local or TEST_ONLY evidence never grants authority
parent_goal_rule: parent goal remains open until the complete formal route and independent acceptance are satisfied
